response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT r.circuitId AS circuitId, ci.country AS country, AVG(r.round) AS avg_round FROM races r JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.circuitId, ci.country), k AS (SELECT ci.country AS country, AVG(r.round) AS country_avg FROM races r JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY ci.country) SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, c.avg_round, c.avg_round - k.country_avg AS diff FROM c JOIN k ON k.country = c.country ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
